summary: The bounded fluid pipeline has useful buffer contracts, frame-boundary ownership and explicit stop cleanup. Improve shader mathematical layout, dependency diagnostics and shared setup without hiding dispatch or the editable stages.

lenses.smells_idioms: No raw property writes. Identity-guarded target/module cleanup and producer removal are intentional. Named context dependencies are graph exports; keep their graph contract visible.
lenses.imports: Explicit VulkanBuffer imports support overload selection in null casts; deterministic import formatter decides removals. Do not remove library star imports on source appearance alone.
lenses.whitespace: Expand compressed moduleHere and cleanup blocks; group resource settings, exported buffers, parameters and targets. Apply ktfmt candidates with authored controls kept discoverable.
lenses.comments: Most comments explain contracts and units. Correct the half-height/half-width wording; explain packed item data and pressure iteration parity near the editable constants.
lenses.glsl: Read all compute, vertex and fragment bodies. Preserve buffer layouts, generation bits, include names and UV conventions; break dense bilinear interpolation, resampling and shadow expressions into readable steps.
lenses.live_coding: Keep once renderer setup, controls assignments, reset ticket and identity checks. No fragment breaks should be introduced. Re-run/stop must not remove replacement registrations.
lenses.helpers: Reuse the already-approved computeBarrier/fullscreenTriangle work where semantics match. No automatic dispatch-size helper: explicitly declined. A generic pass chain would hide the point of this example.

findings.issue: The strokes setup puts the first setting on the opening line and the last on the closing line; cleanup blocks elsewhere are similarly compressed.
findings.proposed_change: Expand module settings and identity-guarded cleanup into ordinary blocks, and format Kotlin with the editor formatter.
findings.verification: Replay twice and stop; compare render-list membership and visible strokes.

findings.snippet: Visible vertical half-width in world units.
findings.issue: The parameter is named View half-height and is used as height in the projection. The half-width comment gives the reader the wrong unit interpretation.
findings.proposed_change: Use vertical half-height in resource/control comments.
findings.verification: Inspect projection and change flowWidth alone; the vertical framing must match the label.

findings.issue: The bilinear sample is compressed into one expression with repeated offsets and no visual separation between the two rows. Particle respawning and the final motion/debug expressions have the same problem.
findings.proposed_change: Space expressions consistently and name the lower/upper row samples; add only a short note identifying cell-centred interpolation and generation rejection.
findings.verification: Compile shaders and compare deterministic reset renders, including tile-boundary travel and velocity/motion debug views.

findings.issue: Five stages repeat barrier task construction and typed null overload selection. Pressure uses compute-only barriers while other stages also publish graphics reads.
findings.proposed_change: Apply the already-approved computeBarrier helper after its scope semantics are explicit; retain the compute versus graphics distinction and explicit dispatch sizes.
findings.verification: GPU validation and reset/travel rendering must show no compute-to-compute or compute-to-graphics hazards.

findings.issue: The profiling reset wait checks completed but not SimulationReset.failure. That API records failure without completing the ticket, so a failed reset can leave this profiling coroutine waiting until manually stopped.
findings.proposed_change: Check the reset failure while waiting and report it with a bounded wait; keep finally restoring travel and stopping an active recording.
findings.verification: Inject a reset callback failure and confirm the profile exits with the error and restores travel; also verify normal 60-frame warmup and 180-frame capture.

verification_needed: Replay the full connected graph twice, stop child/resource boxes and verify no stale modules or producer hooks remain.
Compile all GLSL stages; compare deterministic reset frames, travelling tile boundaries, all five debug views and window resizing.
Exercise profile reset failure and normal capture; preserve travel restoration and recording cleanup.
